_help.how_to_use: Edit the values below. On GitHub, saving (committing) this file rebuilds the live website automatically within a few minutes. On your own computer, run python3 build.py and the website is written to ../site/
_help.phone_link: The phone number with no spaces, used for click-to-call. Example: +9779801234567
_help.domain: Your website address with https:// and no slash at the end. Used for Google, sharing previews and the sitemap. Change it to your own domain (e.g. https://www.ilainfotech.com) when you move off GitHub Pages.
_help.form_email: Where contact and quote forms are delivered. Leave empty to use 'email'. The first message sent after launch asks you to click an activation link (FormSubmit).
_help.web3forms_key: Optional. Paste a free access key from web3forms.com to send forms through Web3Forms instead of FormSubmit.
_help.social: Paste full profile links. Empty ones are hidden from the site.
_help.logo: Optional. Put your logo file in images/ and write its path here, e.g. images/logo.png. Empty uses the IL letter mark.
_help.opening_hours_schema: Office hours in the format Google reads: days Mo Tu We Th Fr Sa Su, 24-hour times.
